subject.title: memory_search: chokidar file watcher silently stops delivering events, index goes stale

question: Should OpenClaw change unconfigured memorySearch.sync.intervalMinutes from disabled to a default periodic fallback, or keep periodic memory reindex opt-in and solve watcher staleness another way?
rationale: The narrow technical fix touches config/default and background indexing behavior, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive for existing users.

options.title: Default periodic fallback
options.body: Accept a non-zero default interval after the code path is scoped and tested so watcher outages eventually self-heal for unconfigured users.

options.title: Keep opt-in interval
options.body: Keep the default at 0 and solve the outage through watcher health/restart diagnostics or documentation instead.

recommendation.title: Default periodic fallback
recommendation.body: Accept a non-zero default interval after the code path is scoped and tested so watcher outages eventually self-heal for unconfigured users.
